name: Execute stage heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Role heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Orchestrator dispatches every unit
does: Dispatch every unit of work to a fresh-context subagent; implement, review, or document nothing yourself.
preventsClaim: the driver doing implementation work and filling its context
costNote: the source of every per-task spawn below

name: Orchestrator context stays small
does: Hold only the overview, the TODO list, and subagent reports — never a task file or source.
preventsClaim: the orchestrator running out of context mid-plan

name: Synchronous agents, absolute paths
does: Each role is a general-purpose Agent dispatched synchronously with absolute paths, model per interaction.md.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: relative paths failing in a fresh context)
costNote: synchronous means no task parallelism anywhere in execute

name: Before starting heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Read the overview
does: Read 00_overview.md before starting.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 read per execute dispatch

name: Get tasks done
does: Take tasks_done from the dispatching report, or re-run state.ts report; done means the file sits in done/.
preventsClaim: re-running completed tasks
costNote: 0-1 extra node run

name: Baseline gate before first task
does: Before the first task only, run Format, Check, Unit tests; anything failing stops the run.
preventsClaim: blaming the plan's work for a tree that was already broken
costNote: 3 command runs once per plan; full unit suite

name: Build the TODO list
does: Build an ordered TODO list from the remaining Task Index rows.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 entry per remaining task

name: Two-pass mode definition
does: A documenter line in the config's ## Models turns on two-pass mode; otherwise single pass.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: two-pass roughly doubles per-task subagent count

name: Documenter follows every code commit
does: In two-pass mode every code-changing commit is followed immediately by a scoped documenter pass.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: undocumented or AI-slop prose in commits)
costNote: 1 documenter per code commit: per task, per fix round, per gate repair, per acceptance fix

name: Prose defects route to documenter
does: A prose defect goes to the documenter, a not-prose one to an implementer.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the wrong role fixing a defect)
costNote: can split one fix round into two subagents

name: Per task heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Work the TODO list in order
does: Work entries in order, each in_progress while it runs.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: out-of-order or parallel tasks)
costNote: exit: list empty; T iterations, each costing 3-7 subagents

name: Dispatch an implementer
does: Spawn an implementer with the task file, progress log, and config paths.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 per task per attempt; T base spawns per run

name: Log failure friction
does: On failure, append a friction line naming the task and whether it was blocked or stuck.
preventsClaim: unstated (the retrospective reads this log)

name: Blocked stops the run
does: A blocked report stops execution and relays the report.
preventsClaim: grinding on work that cannot proceed
costNote: terminal stop

name: One retry per stuck task
does: A stuck report earns one fresh implementer carrying the previous failure report; a second failure stops.
preventsClaim: unbounded retry of a failing task
costNote: exit: success or second failure; +1 implementer per task worst case

name: Dispatch a documenter
does: In two-pass mode, spawn a documenter scoped to the implementer's commit.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the implementer writing its own prose)
costNote: 1 per successful task in two-pass mode: +T spawns

name: Handle documenter result
does: A docs commit joins the reviewer's Commits; a documenter failure gets one retry and a friction line.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: +1 documenter per task worst case

name: Dispatch a reviewer
does: Spawn a reviewer over every commit this task produced, with task file, config, and progress log.
preventsClaim: unreviewed task work being marked done
costNote: 1 per task; the file states no re-review after a fix round

name: One fix round per task
does: No defects advances; defects log friction and earn exactly one fix round.
preventsClaim: an unbounded review-fix loop per task
costNote: exit: after one round, pass or stop; +1-2 subagents per task

name: Single-pass fix dispatch
does: Single pass sends all defects to one implementer using the step 1 prompt.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 implementer

name: Two-pass fix dispatch
does: Two-pass sends not-prose defects to an implementer, then prose defects to the documenter.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: up to 2 subagents per fix round

name: Unclean fix report stops
does: Anything but a clean success report from the fix round stops the run.
preventsClaim: a half-fixed task being marked done
costNote: terminal stop

name: Record the task done
does: git mv the task file into done/, commit `mise: task <ID> done`, mark the TODO entry completed.
preventsClaim: unstated (this move is the only record of completion)
costNote: 1 mkdir + 1 git mv + 1 commit per task

name: End-of-plan gate heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Gate trigger conditions
does: Run after the last task, on any dispatch with all tasks done and no acceptance, and after later commits.
preventsClaim: a finished plan never being verified as a whole
costNote: re-runs after every repair or acceptance-blocker fix

name: Gate step Format
does: Run Format; a run that leaves changes in the tree is a failure and the repair commits them.
preventsClaim: unformatted code shipping, or format noise in a later diff
costNote: 1 run per gate pass

name: Gate step Check
does: Run Check.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 run per gate pass

name: Gate step unit tests
does: Run the full unit test suite.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 full-suite run per gate pass

name: Gate step e2e and sanity
does: Run the overview's named e2e and sanity suites via the guides entry; absent a section, grep done/ task files.
preventsClaim: e2e suites never being run for the plan as a whole
costNote: the grep fallback is the orchestrator's one sanctioned read of task files

name: One repair per gate run
does: A failed step logs friction, dispatches one repair, and re-runs the gate from step 1; a second failure stops.
preventsClaim: an unbounded gate-repair loop
costNote: exit: gate passes or second failure; each iteration re-runs all 4 gate steps

name: Prose repair via documenter
does: In two-pass mode a prose failure is repaired by the documenter with Fix scope and Defects.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 documenter per gate repair

name: Other repair via implementer
does: Any other gate failure is repaired by an implementer that commits with a Fix: subject.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 implementer per gate repair

name: Acceptance and close-out heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: close_out resumes at retrospective
does: A close_out dispatch starts at the retrospective, skipping the recording clause, and then cleans up.
preventsClaim: re-running the acceptance pass after an interrupted close-out

name: Dispatch acceptance
does: Spawn the acceptance role with requirements, overview, progress log, config, and gate results.
preventsClaim: finished work never checked against its own docs
costNote: 1 per acceptance attempt; re-run after every user-flagged fix

name: Present verdicts, ask close-out
does: Present acceptance verdicts as returned and ask whether to close the feature out.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: verdicts filtered before the user sees them)
costNote: 1 user turn; the second of the two human gates

name: Only flagged items are blockers
does: Fix only the verdicts the user flags, log friction, then re-run the gate and acceptance.
preventsClaim: the workflow acting on verdicts the user accepted
costNote: exit: the user confirms; no iteration bound stated — each round is 1+ subagents, a full gate and a new acceptance

name: Record acceptance and commit
does: On confirmation run `state.ts approve <dir> acceptance` and commit `mise: accept`.
preventsClaim: unstated (the record is what makes close-out resumable)
costNote: 1 node run + 1 commit

name: Retrospective unless off
does: Run the retrospective unless the config carries `Retrospective: off`.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 subagent per run when on

name: Dispatch retrospective
does: Spawn the retrospective role with the mise directory and config paths.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: friction never turning into guidance)
costNote: 1 per run; reads _friction.md

name: Present proposals, ask adoption
does: Present proposals verbatim with the Recommend line and ask which to adopt by number; adopting is never required.
preventsClaim: guidance changing without the user choosing it
costNote: 1 user turn

name: Apply adopted proposals only
does: Apply adopted proposals exactly, to project guidance only, in one commit; relay plugin candidates.
preventsClaim: a retrospective editing source code or the plugin
costNote: 1 commit

name: Delete the mise directory
does: Delete the mise directory entirely, commit `mise: cleanup`, report the feature finished.
preventsClaim: workflow artifacts reaching merged history
costNote: 1 commit

name: Ship per config
does: Ship per the config's value: open a PR, merge in the recorded style, or report the branch ready.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: asks 1-2 questions when Ship or the merge style is unrecorded

name: Stopping rules heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Six stop conditions only
does: Stop only at: baseline failure, blocked, surviving stuck, unclean fix round, second gate failure, unresolvable ambiguity.
preventsClaim: the orchestrator halting for anything the docs can resolve

name: Red state is a planning bug
does: A subagent reporting that a task authorizes a red intermediate state stops the run for a plan regeneration.
preventsClaim: executing a plan that breaks the build midway
costNote: terminal stop; sends the run back to the plan stage

name: Skill default beats task note
does: A task note never overrides a skill default on a safety or verification rule.
preventsClaim: a generated task file weakening verification rules

name: Do not list heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Never skip a gate
does: Never skip the baseline gate, end-of-plan gate, or acceptance pass, or let a subagent skip verification.
preventsClaim: unverified work being accepted

name: Never fix unflagged verdicts
does: Never fix anything in the acceptance verdicts the user did not flag.
preventsClaim: post-acceptance scope creep

name: Never retry past the bound
does: One fresh subagent per stuck, one fix round per task, one repair per gate run.
preventsClaim: unbounded subagent spend on a failing task or gate
costNote: caps per-task spawns at 3 implementer + 3 documenter + 1 reviewer

name: Never ship before cleanup
does: Never delete the mise directory, open a PR, or merge before the user's confirmation and the cleanup commit.
preventsClaim: shipping a branch whose tree still holds workflow artifacts

name: Never apply unadopted proposals
does: Never apply a proposal the user did not adopt, or let one touch source code or plugin files.
preventsClaim: a retrospective silently rewriting code or the plugin
